title: crataegus horrida var. longiacuminata
intro: Crataegus horrida var. longiacuminata, commonly known as the hawthorn, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. The hawthorn plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and improve lipid profiles. The therapeutic actions of the hawthorn plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and triterpenoids, which have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the hawthorn plant have been shown to improve cardiovascular function, reduce inflammation, and exhibit vasodilatory effects.
